hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Kestrel Group Life Assurance pays a lump sum to a member's nominated beneficiaries if the member dies while covered under a participating employer's scheme. Cover is provided under a group policy issued to the employer or retirement fund.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
- Members must be permanent employees of the participating employer.
- The maximum entry age is 64. Cover ends at the scheme's normal retirement age, or age 65 at the latest.
- Members must be actively at work on the date cover starts. If not, cover starts on the date they return to full duties.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age must apply within 60 days of leaving service to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy, without providing medical evidence. The cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: The 60-day application time limit, no medical evidence needed, and the cap of the lower of group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: The excerpt covers the Group Life continuation option only; the documents do not say whether the same rule applies to disability income or funeral cover.
